description: Implementation of a JSON parser class with methods for parsing JSON strings, handling escape sequences, decoding UTF-16, and managing parsing errors.

classes.name: JSONParser
classes.description: A class for parsing JSON strings into internal data structures, with error handling and support for nested structures.

classes.name: JSONParser::StringBuilder
classes.description: Helper class for efficiently building JSON strings during parsing, handling Unicode characters and escape sequences.

classes.name: JSONParser::StackMarker
classes.description: Utility class to check for maximum recursion depth during parsing to prevent stack overflow.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a JSON string view into a Value object.

methods.name: GetNextToken
methods.description: Retrieves the next token from the input stream, skipping whitespace and comments.

methods.name: ConsumeStringRaw
methods.description: Parses a raw JSON string, handling escape sequences and Unicode decoding.

methods.name: DecodeUTF16
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-16 escape sequence into a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ConsumeNumber
methods.description: Parses a JSON number, supporting integer, fractional, and exponent parts.

methods.name: ConsumeLiteral
methods.description: Parses JSON literals: true, false, null.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Records a parsing error with specific error code, line, and column.
